Subject: Mutual plan kickoff & SE/Eng introductions — Ava Systems evaluation

Hi Liam & Maya,

Thanks again for the time last week — it was great to hear more about Ava Systems' goals for using embeddings and retrieval to power your internal search + assist experience. As promised, I wanted to kick off a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear owners, milestones, and a proposed close window.

High-level goal: Production-ready retrieval + semantic search prototype integrated into internal support tooling by end of Q1.

Proposed 6-week MAP (first pass):
- Week 0 (this week): Stakeholder alignment, infra inventory, access + test dataset share
- Week 1–2: SE-led POC (embedding selection, vector store, latency baseline)
- Week 3: Integration tests, throughput tuning, cost projection
- Week 4: Evaluation against quality bar (recall@K, human evals)
- Week 5: Rollout plan, documentation, handoff to infra/ops

Key roles (please confirm):
- Redwood: Priyom Das (AE, map owner), Diego Fernandez (Solutions Engineer, technical lead), Neha Kapoor (Commercial lead)
- Ava Systems: Liam O'Connor (CTO), Maya Patel (Engineering lead / integration owner)

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the internal engineering lead who will own integration work?
2) Share a small sample dataset and a high-level architecture diagram (if available).
3) Quick intro call for SE + Eng alignment — proposed times below.

Proposed SE/Eng intro slots (PST):
- Tue 13 Jan, 10:00–10:30
- Wed 14 Jan, 15:00–15:30
- Thu 15 Jan, 09:00–09:30

I've attached a draft MAP and a short eval scope spreadsheet to make it easy to confirm timelines.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

- I'll ask our data team to package a 2–3k row sample (support tickets + metadata) and share via the secure link by EOD Wednesday.

Hi Maya & Liam — great to meet you (virtually). I'm Diego, Solutions Engineer on the Redwood side; I'll be the technical lead for your POC. A few things I want to call out ahead of our sync tomorrow: 

Short technical checklist for the POC (we'll walk through on the call):
- Data: sample CSV/JSON with ticket text + id + created_at + product_tag
- Auth & network: VPC peering or temporary peered sandbox; list of allowed egress endpoints
- Model selection: start with open embedding model recommended in MAP (small/fast) and evaluate 2 larger variants for quality
- Storage: vector store options (Redis module, Faiss, or Pinecone if you prefer hosted) — we can run a quick benchmark
- Observability: token-level latency, per-request cost, error histogram — we'll enable tracing to your workspace for the POC

Proposed outcome for the first two weeks:
1) Baseline: embeddings + retrieval working end-to-end with sample data
2) Latency/cost baseline + recommendations for batching/quantization
3) A short report with quality metrics and recommended next steps

Attachments: a one-page network checklist (stub): SOW-draft-avasys.docx referenced below.

I'll be on the Tue 13 Jan 10:00 PST slot (see you then).

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
